title: September 1993 meeting with Wright-Patterson FASTC colonel

tellings.quote: the colonel in charge of the Wright Patterson Air Force Base operations for this uh Colonel Canola when he said to me

plain: In September 1993, Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for government disclosure of UFOs, says he met the colonel in charge of the relevant operations at Wright-Patterson, an Air Force base in Ohio. The colonel worked for FASTC, the Foreign Aerospace Science and Technology Center, an Air Force intelligence office based there. Greer tells Michels he was there and recalls what a man he calls Colonel Canola said to him, and he brings an Admiral Kramer into the same account. If his account is right, officers at the base where UFO material is often said to be kept were talking with him directly about it.
